points.guidance:
Standardising with their values.

Allow with missing or incorrect continuity correction.
For area consistent with their working.

For $\text{P}_{\text{o}}(100p)$ expression.

Accept un-simplified terms (e.g. $p^0/0!$ For M1).

Allow one end error (e.g. for correct with extra term $\text{e}^{-100p} \times \frac{(100p)^3}{3!}$ oe), or brackets omitted.

Must have brackets.

Allow with or without ! sign (but not $0!$ or $p^0$).

ISW once a fully correct answer seen.
